title: show --notes reaches every note: a bounded window that prioritizes the newest notes rendered chronologically with explicit direction, an item-bound continuation for older pages, exact counts, and a detail path for a single over-budget note; history likewise
outcome: show --notes reaches every note: a bounded window that prioritizes the newest notes rendered chronologically with explicit direction, an item-bound continuation for older pages, exact counts, and a detail path for a single over-budget note; history likewise
acceptance: a single note larger than the budget is reachable through a detail path instead of making it and every later note unreachable; history uses the same window and continuation shape; docs state that notes[].summary in full-note mode is the complete stored body

show REF --notes renders the newest notes that fit in feed order oldest-to-newest within the window, states the window direction and exact notes_omitted, and prints one continuation command bound to the item that reaches every older note; a fixture with a newer verdict note after enough old material to exceed the budget shows the verdict on the first page

completion.summary: Delivered newest-first note and history windows with exact continuation, complete immutable note detail, 64 KiB note-write limits, CLI/MCP parity, relative attribution, verified restored-record reuse, and live-path integrity and omission regressions.
